summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of 1,912,893 of its own ordinary shares across five trading days (6–10 July 2026) from JPMorgan at a volume-weighted average price of approximately 10.31 GBP per share, totaling about GBP 19.7M. The buyback is executed under authority from the 2025 AGM and an arrangement announced on 6 January 2026. Prudential intends to cancel the repurchased shares. This is an on-market, open-market share repurchase program, not a tender offer. The company has bought 45.65M shares since the program began in January. Watch for continued pace of repurchases and impact on share count and EPS.
